stage: Stage 4 -- protective exits and EOD compatibility

claims_proven.claim: Disabling a ticker's paper_entry_enabled AFTER a position is opened does not suppress its stop exit
A ticker that was NEVER entry-enabled (readiness/entry failure) still has an existing position fully managed
Target-price exits are unaffected by the new decision/execution contract
EOD reconciliation retries are idempotent -- no duplicate cancel_all_orders/close_all_positions calls
The original live session_id remains attached across an EOD retry (Task 72O's own fix, re-verified unbroken)
A reconciliation mismatch (broker still reports a position after close) resolves FAILED, never a false PASSED, and SESSION_COMPLETED never fires on it
A broker outage during cancel resolves INCONCLUSIVE, never a false PASSED

note: eod_lifecycle.py itself is read, not modified -- these tests exercise its existing, unmodified idempotency/session-identity/mismatch-handling contract against the new lifecycle.py boundary changes, proving no interaction regression.
